gloss: to take in; to consume (nutrients, food)

definitions.gloss: to take in; to ingest; to consume (food, nutrients, sleep)
definitions.explanation: To take something into the body, especially nutrients, food, water, or sleep. This kanji spelling distinguishes it from other verbs read とる; it often appears in health and nutrition contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{摂|と}る。
⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こまめ→こまめ：10325_komame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{摂|と}りましょう。
⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧{摂|と}るようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Even when I'm busy, I make sure to eat a proper breakfast.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive; the thing consumed is marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. Common objects are ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧ (nutrition), ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧ (fluids), ⟦カロリー→カロリー：06109_karorii⟧ (calories), ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧ (a meal), and ⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧ (sleep).

This is one of several verbs read とる. {摂|と}る is reserved for taking nutrients, food, or sleep into the body. For grabbing or picking up objects use ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧, and the general kana spelling とる covers all of these readings in casual writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{栄養|えいよう}→栄養：01882_eiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{摂|と}る: to take in nutrition
- ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{摂|と}る: to stay hydrated
- ⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{摂|と}る: to get sleep
